formats.title: Standard collapsible report
formats.description: One reusable report format: editorial header, section navigation, native collapsible sections, metrics, and evidence. Content, branding, and TAC depth vary within this format.
formats.label: Report format

formats.title: Artifact library
formats.description: Distinct gallery body: editorial heading, count tiles, search and filter toolbar, lifecycle chips, preview-card grid, and inspector. Selected Atlas style reference.
formats.label: Gallery format

formats.title: Landing gallery
formats.description: Distinct landing gallery body: dark image field, Grid/Globe exploration, pan, orbit, zoom, and focus then inspect. Selected Atlas style reference.
formats.label: Gallery format

formats.title: Landing / campaign page
formats.description: Hero, navigation, value sections, and calls to action. Different subjects share this same page format.
formats.label: Landing page

formats.title: Interactive workspace
formats.description: A persistent tool rail and canvas with configurable nodes, controls, and outputs. Reuses the existing workflow and Forge workspaces.
formats.label: Workspace format

formats.title: Onboarding / form page
formats.description: A focused input and validation flow with supporting context. Reuses the existing account-initialization page.
formats.label: Form format

formats.title: Editorial profile / resume
formats.description: A structured editorial document with profile, skills, experience, and contact information. Reuses the public GBAuto AI resume.
formats.label: Document format

formats.title: Carousel story
formats.description: A horizontal sequence of narrative cards designed for swipe-based reading. Reuses the existing productivity carousel.
formats.label: Story format

formats.title: Chart Pack
formats.description: Up to six ECharts-style views in one report slot, with compact previews and a full-size modal. Embedded visual format; existing style-guide reference.
formats.label: Visual format

formats.title: Interactive Kanban
formats.description: A calm board summary with clickable tasks, typed gates, and a detail surface for ownership and evidence. Embedded visual format; existing style-guide reference.
formats.label: Visual format

formats.title: Gantt Timeline
formats.description: The recovered sprint-report timeline, modernized as an accessible HTML/SVG pattern rather than an approved engine. Embedded visual format; existing style-guide reference.
formats.label: Visual format

formats.title: Manim / Motion
formats.description: A motion storyboard for the one high-level insight that earns animation. Reports retain a poster and written fallback. Embedded visual format; existing style-guide reference.
formats.label: Visual format

formats.title: Mermaid DAG
formats.description: Timestamped task lineage with a collapsed source receipt and node details that stay readable without a diagram runtime. Embedded visual format; existing style-guide reference.
formats.label: Visual format

formats.title: Sankey / 3D Flow
formats.description: Use wide paths when flow volume is the point. Three.js adds depth only when it improves stage comprehension. Embedded visual format; existing style-guide reference.
formats.label: Visual format

formats.title: Bokeh Crossfilter
formats.description: Server-app interaction grammar: change one dimension and linked metrics, scatter points, and distributions update. Embedded visual format; existing style-guide reference.
formats.label: Visual format
